mapper.update: UPDATE db_database SET system_id = #{systemId}, db_user = #{dbUser}, db_name = #{dbName}, db_type = #{dbType}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, env = #{env}, jdbc_url = #{jdbcUrl}, credential_id = #{credentialId}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , s.system_name AS system_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM db_table_doc t WHERE t.database_id = d.id AND t.status = 1) AS table_count FROM db_database d LEFT JOIN db_system s ON s.id = d.system_id WHERE d.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
